ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamentals of tall building design. Overview of design and construction phases; structural systems for tall buildings - lateral, floor, and foundations; wind engineering and application of wind tunnel testing; loading considerations and analysis procedures; integration of structural systems with architectural and mechanical/electrical/plumbing system components; structural materials selection; construction methods and designing for constructability; project case studies Prerequisites: CEE460 and CEE461 Restricted to online non-degree, online MCS, online MSAE, online MSME, and online MSCE students. Non-Degree students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Program Coordinator, Meg Griffin (mgriffn@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS:Env Engr CivilEngr ONL-UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, MENG:Engr:Energy Sys Onl-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC, MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC, MENG:Bioeng:Gen Bioeng On-UIUC, MENG:Bioeng:Comp Gen Onl -UIUC, MENG:Bioeng:Bioinstr Onl -UIUC, MENG:Bioengr:Pharm ONL- UIUC, MENG:Engr:AeroSys Online- UIUC, or MENG:Engr:Plasma Online-UIUC.
